items.source: Gets published after instantiation and setting of all the properties of an entity. If you want to mutate an entity after loading, use AfterConvertCallback.
items.translation: 在实体实例化并设置所有属性后发布。如果您想在加载后修改实体，请使用AfterConvertCallback。

items.source: entity - the newly instantiated entity. Must not be null.
items.translation: entity - 新实例化的实体。不能为 null。
